fields.description:
## Context
Evaluate the current rebar repository for code quality, architectural quality, documentation quality (discoverability, understandability, and context efficiency), and test quality (behavioral, contractual, and external-integration coverage; avoidance of vacuous/change-detector tests; shared fixtures; and test hygiene). This is a read-only assessment; do not modify production or test files.

## Plan
- Map the implementation and package boundaries, dependency directions, public interfaces, state ownership, and high-complexity hotspots.
- Sample representative production paths for correctness, cohesion, readability, typing, error handling, and maintainability.
- Trace the documentation entry points, indexes, cross-links, generated references, architecture/ADR coverage, contributor guidance, and duplicated context.
- Inventory and sample unit, interface/contract, integration, property, golden, snapshot, subprocess, and external-service tests; inspect fixture reuse, isolation, determinism, assertions, skips, and CI execution.
- Run read-only repository quality gates and targeted test-collection/coverage diagnostics where safe.
- Report evidence-backed strengths and prioritized findings with exact citations, confidence, and remediation guidance.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The report assesses code quality with evidence and representative citations.
- [x] The report assesses architectural boundaries, dependency direction, cohesion, and extension surfaces with evidence.
- [x] The report assesses documentation discoverability, understandability, accuracy signals, and context efficiency with evidence.
- [x] The report assesses behavioral, contractual, and external-integration test coverage with evidence.
- [x] The report assesses vacuous/change-detector risk, fixture reuse, isolation, determinism, and test hygiene with evidence.
- [x] Material findings have a severity, impact explanation, and concrete remedy.
- [x] The final evaluation distinguishes verified observations from sampling limits and records conclusions on this ticket.
